items.summary:

items.title: The AI Industry Asks Government to Slow It Down
items.summary: Over 1,100 AI lab employees — including Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Pachocki, and Meta's chief scientist — signed a letter begging the US government to build tools to "pace the frontier." NLW walks through the good, the bad, and the surprisingly hopeful, and argues the whole thing may prove we're not sleepwalking into disaster after all.
